statement:
∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ),
  a ≤ b → Continuous f → Continuous g → (∀ x ∈ Icc a b, f x ≤ g x) → ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, f x ≤ ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, g x

universal.type: ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, f x ≤ g x
universal.name: h

hyps.text: ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, f x ≤ g x
hyps.name: h

goal.text: ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, f x ≤ ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, g x
goal.expr: (definite_integral(F_f(i0_), i0_, x2, x3)) - (definite_integral(F_g(i0_), i0_, x2, x3))
